climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Mendocino County valley AVA about 200 feet higher than its surroundings, near the Eel River watershed. Conditions favor botrytized wines, particularly Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Riesling, Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon.
